title: The Holy Spirit
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child lists the nine gifts of the Spirit (1 Corinthians 12:8-10: wisdom, knowledge, faith, healing, miracles, prophecy, discerning spirits, tongues, interpretation), tells them from the nine fruit (Galatians 5:22-23), and explains how the fruit bring harmony.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the nine fruit of the Spirit.
floor.question: Name three fruit of the Spirit.

steps: Sort cards into gifts and fruit.
Say how one fruit brings harmony.
contexts: a family with patience during hard times

board.do: Draw two baskets: gifts and fruit.
Wait for the child to say gift.

misconceptions.ask: Which one is a fruit of the Holy Spirit?
misconceptions.repair: Make two lists, gifts from 1 Corinthians 12 and fruit from Galatians 5.

misconceptions.ask: How many gifts of the Holy Spirit are listed in 1 Corinthians 12:1-11?
misconceptions.repair: Count the gifts in verses 8 to 10 together.

listen_for: It makes them leave quarrels unsolved
misconceptions.ask: How does the fruit of patience help Christians?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what a patient friend does when you make a mistake.

misconceptions.ask: To whom does the Spirit give gifts, according to 1 Corinthians 12:7?
misconceptions.repair: Read 1 Corinthians 12:7 and 12:11: to each one, as the Spirit decides.

checks.question: Is kindness a gift or a fruit of the Spirit?
How many gifts are listed in 1 Corinthians 12:8-10?
